correctness.rationale: There are exactly 2^4=16 projective real flat sign lines after normalizing coordinate one. Independently coded fraction-free integer Bareiss determinants for every C(16,5)=4368 five-line set, checked all C(16,6)=8008 six-line sets and C(16,7)=11440 seven-line sets; 1088 six-line sets are full spark and zero seven-line sets, with an explicit six-line witness. A separate generator-orbit traversal using coordinate sign flips and adjacent swaps yielded five orbits of sizes 16,160,192,240,480, summing to 1088. Completeness follows because any >=7 full-spark set contains a 7-subset. The published Theorem 3.8 then forbids eight flat vectors as minimal weak phase retrieval in R5; does not rule out nonflat frames.
